Bags, Vectors & Transformers · Day 2

Embedding Playground

Explore GloVe word vectors, the same 50-dimensional vectors as in the Day 2 notebook. Type a word and see where it sits in meaning-space. Lowercase works best.

Nearest neighbors

The words whose vectors point in the most similar direction (cosine similarity).

Loading vectors…

Compare two words

1 means the same direction, 0 means unrelated. Most word pairs land between 0 and 0.9.

Analogy

A is to B as C is to … ? Computed as B − A + C, then the nearest words (A, B and C themselves are left out).

: ::

Two poles

Is each word closer to pole A or pole B? Score = similarity to A minus similarity to B. A pole can be several words (separated by commas), which is more reliable than a single word.

Odd one out

Which word fits least with the others? The word least similar to the group's average direction.

Vocabulary: the 30,000 most common words in GloVe, plus the examples from the course. GloVe (Pennington, Socher & Manning, 2014), glove-wiki-gigaword-50: trained on Wikipedia and newswire from before 2015. The vectors are compressed to load quickly on a phone, so scores can differ from the notebook in the second decimal.
